description: Current road events: accidents, roadworks, congestion, traffic control and weather closures, plus announced events (parades, planned works) for cities and provincial highways, with where they are and how much they block. Example: network "freeway", type "accident"; or network "Taipei", lat 25.0478, lon 121.517.

keyword.description: Only results whose road or place contains this, e.g. "國道1號", "林口", "建國高架".

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (default 20).

network.description: Road network: "freeway" (國道, national freeways), "highway" (省道, provincial highways) or a city (Taipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, 臺北市, ...).

type.description: Only one kind: accident, works, congestion, control, weather, disaster, event, other.

name: traffic_events
title: Road incidents and closures
